exposure: fetal exposure to injectable first-line treatments (dimethyl fumarate, glatiramer acetate, or natalizumab)
cohort: The study participants included newborns of Danish women with multiple sclerosis, with and without fetal exposure to specific disease-modifying drugs, and a comparison group of newborns from the general population.
finding: Fetal exposure to injectable first-line disease-modifying drugs was not associated with an increased risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes when compared to either unexposed pregnancies or the general population.
